actions.action: Stop watering until top inch of soil is dry (check soil)
Slide plant out and check roots
Separate seedlings and repot each into its own draining container with fresh potting mix
Remove black, mushy or very yellow leaves
Move to south-facing window or add a grow light
Keep plant warm away from cold drafts and glass
Water only when top inch is dry, ensuring drainage
Backup: take stem cuttings and root them in water

reason: The answer diagnoses overwatering when the plant was underwatered, and its main advice to stop watering and repot would delay the soak it urgently needed.
